description: This file defines a class 'BitWise' that implements bitwise operations such as AND, OR, XOR, left shift, and right shift for use in Excel calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. The class includes methods for splitting numbers into upper and lower bits, validating arguments, and handling array inputs.

classes.name: BitWise
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for performing bitwise operations in Excel calculations.

methods.name: BITAND
methods.description: Returns the bitwise AND of two integer values, supporting array inputs for vectorized calculations.

methods.name: BITOR
methods.description: Returns the bitwise OR of two integer values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITXOR
methods.description: Returns the bitwise XOR of two integer values, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: BITLSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts a number left by the specified number of bits, validating input and handling large results.

methods.name: BITRSHIFT
methods.description: Shifts a number right by the specified number of bits, validating input.

methods.name: validateBitwiseArgument
methods.description: Validates that an argument for bitwise operations is numeric and within acceptable range.

methods.name: validateShiftAmount
methods.description: Validates the shift amount argument for shift operations.

methods.name: nullFalseTrueToNumber
methods.description: Converts null, boolean values to numeric equivalents for bitwise functions.
